description: This file contains utility functions for managing bundled plugin build entries, including reading package.json files, determining public surface files, collecting build entries, listing build artifacts, and runtime dependencies, primarily used to facilitate plugin bundle management for a project.

methods.name: readBundledPluginPackageJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a package.json file from a given path, returning null if the file does not exist or parsing fails.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package is a manifest-less bundled runtime support package based on its name and surface entries.

methods.name: collectPluginSourceEntries
methods.description: Collects source entries for a plugin from its package.json configuration, defaults to './index.ts' if none found.

methods.name: shouldStageBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Checks whether runtime dependencies should be staged based on package.json settings.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Collects top-level public surface files from a plugin directory, filtering out non-source or test files.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Main function that collects all build entries for plugins within the extensions root directory, considering manifests and package.json configuration.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Returns a mapping of build entry paths to their normalized file paths for a set of plugin build entries.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Lists all artifacts (JSON files, JS files, etc.) generated during plugin build, including dependencies and manifest files.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of runtime dependencies for plugins that should have their dependencies staged.
